title: ScanReport
description: Final, signable and diffable output of a scan run. The same input produces byte identical output.
$comment: The signature is NOT inside this object. It lives in a detached envelope, so a signed and an unsigned report are byte identical.

envelope.description: Time and environment. The single exception to the body hash scope, which is why two reports of the same tree at different times still hash identically.

verdict.description: Computed by policy, never written inside a finding. A coverage gap alone may not produce WARN; a declared threshold must be crossed and recorded in policy_ref.rule_hits.

findings.description: Confirmed findings only, sorted by finding_id ascending.

suspect_findings.description: Heuristic findings, carried separately so they never blend into the confirmed list.

policy_ref.description: Without this block a report cannot be reproduced or audited.

rule_hits.description: Which rule carried which finding or condition to which verdict. Sorted by rule_id ascending.

coverage_condition.description: Present when the hit came from a coverage threshold rather than a finding. A PASS over a known coverage gap is only valid with such a record.

diagnostics.description: Engine, rule and schema errors. Strictly separate from the coverage statement, because polluting coverage counters makes policy coverage thresholds meaningless. Required; an empty array is valid.
